ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (24) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Призвание» (prizvanie, 'calling') and «служение» (sluzhenie, 'service') are kept constant; «самоотвержение» (samootverzhenie) is 'self-sacrifice' and «себялюбие» (sebyalyubie) 'self-love'. «Воспитание» (vospitanie) is 'upbringing', and «зло» (zlo) in reading 4 is 'evil', not the website draft's 'harm'.
Source observation: [13] Section numbers run 1, 2, 3, 5: the number 4 is missing in the source (the paragraph in block [12] presumably being reading 4); translated as printed.
